correctness.rationale: For the zero-at-Q/all-ones-elsewhere trace, a partition block yields a private crossing pair; conversely graph components of selected zero-label witness edges realize every pattern. The chosen private-pair graph has no cycle: along a cycle, each fixed split flips exactly once, a contradiction. At n−1 edges it is a spanning tree whose splits must be fundamental cuts; pairwise split-separation counts recover tree distances and uniqueness. The all-positive path of a complete online tree requires each queried split to refine the common atom partition, so depth<=n−1. Independent full trace enumeration and Prüfer comparisons checked coefficients for n=3,4,5 and n=4/5 nonpure facets, not a substitute for infinite n proof.
